title: Condensed E module categories and the specified restricted exchange
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a normed finite field extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a scheme $T$. Let $\mathbf{Prof}$ be the category of profinite sets (compact Hausdorff totally disconnected spaces) with its coherent topology, whose covers are finite jointly surjective families, and let $\operatorname{Sh}_{\mathrm{Ab}}(\mathbf{Prof})$ be its abelian sheaf category. Let $\underline E\in\operatorname{Sh}_{\mathrm{Ab}}(\mathbf{Prof})$ have sections $\underline E(S)=C(S,E)$, continuous functions with pointwise addition and multiplication. Let $a:\mathbf{Prof}\to(\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z)_{\mathrm{proet}}$ be the site functor $S\mapsto\operatorname{Spec}\operatorname{LC}(S,\mathbf Z)$, where $\operatorname{LC}$ denotes locally constant functions. Write $a^*:\operatorname{Sh}_{\mathrm{Ab}}(\mathbf{Prof})\to\operatorname{Sh}_{\mathrm{Ab}}((\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z)_{\mathrm{proet}})$ for the left Kan extension along $a^{op}$ followed by sheafification. For the structure morphism $\pi_T:T\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$, its inverse image is $\pi_T^{-1}:\operatorname{Sh}_{\mathrm{Ab}}((\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z)_{\mathrm{proet}})\to\operatorname{Sh}_{\mathrm{Ab}}(T_{\mathrm{proet}})$. Set $p_T^*=\pi_T^{-1}\circ a^*$ and $E_T^c=p_T^*(\underline E)$, with the induced ring-object structure.

Let $\mathcal M_T^c(E)$ be the category of internal $E_T^c$-modules in abelian sheaves on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$: an object is an abelian sheaf $M$ with a unital associative action $E_T^c\otimes M\to M$, and arrows commute with the action. Tensor denotes the sheaf tensor product; the abelian sheaf tensor product and the internal action give exactly the usual sectionwise module laws. Form $D(\mathcal M_T^c(E))$ by localizing cochain complexes at maps inducing isomorphisms on every cohomology sheaf. Define $\mathcal C_T^c(E)$ as its full subcategory of complexes with cohomology zero outside a finite interval, and such that each cohomology sheaf admits a finite stratification of $T$ by locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification] on which it is pro-etale locally the cokernel of a map $(E_T^c)^m\to(E_T^c)^n$ with $m,n$ finite nonnegative integers; restrictions use the inverse image of the ring and its module action. This is the archived category $\mathrm{ProEtale.BoundedConstructible}(\mathrm{condensedRingObj}(C(-,E),T))$, with local finite presentation exactly as in its definition, and no completeness condition imposed.

For a scheme morphism $h:T\to U$, the canonical coefficient isomorphism $\alpha_h:h^{-1}E_U^c\xrightarrow{\sim} E_T^c$ is the component of the composition comparison $h^{-1}p_U^*\cong p_T^*$. Its adjoint is $\eta_h:E_U^c\to h_*E_T^c$. Define $h_c^*M=E_T^c\otimes_{h^{-1}E_U^c}h^{-1}M$ and $h_{c,*}N=h_*N$ with coefficient action through $\eta_h$. Write $Lh_c^*$ and $Rh_{c,*}$ for the unbounded derived functors of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], applied with the coefficient identification $\alpha_h$. Whenever these preserve the displayed full subcategories, restrict them and their adjunction there. For a commutative square with $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g':X'\to X$ and $f\circ g'=g\circ f'$, define the restricted base-change transformation as the composite
$$
 Lg_c^*Rf_{c,*}\xrightarrow{\eta_{f'}}Rf'_{c,*}Lf_c'^*Lg_c^*Rf_{c,*}\xrightarrow{Rf'_{c,*}\theta}Rf'_{c,*}Lg_c'^*Lf_c^*Rf_{c,*}\xrightarrow{Rf'_{c,*}Lg_c'^*\epsilon_f}Rf'_{c,*}Lg_c'^*.
$$
Here $\theta:Lf_c'^*Lg_c^*\cong Lg_c'^*Lf_c^*$ is the comparison from pullback composition and square commutativity, $\eta_{f'}$ is the adjunction unit and $\epsilon_f$ is its counit. This is the precise unit-insertion, square-transport, counit-contraction definition of the archived boundedConstructibleBaseChange.
